summary: Tiziana Life Sciences Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 14, 2026, announcing initial quantitative PET imaging results from two patients with Multiple System Atrophy (MSA) in a Phase 2 clinical trial treated with intranasal foralumab. The press release reports reduced brain inflammation with up to 35% reduction in SUV and 24% reduction in SUVR in affected regions. This is a routine disclosure of clinical trial results, not a special situation. No deal terms, changes in corporate structure, or strategic alternatives are involved. The filing is operational in nature, with no acquisition, divestiture, activist, or other special-situation element.
